nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What effect does an electricity price surcharge have in the 2015/16 Irish scenario?
nodes.answer: An electricity price surcharge shifts the burden from those with lower incomes towards those with higher incomes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Reneawable energy adoption|Feed-in tariffs_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What type of support did renewable energy generation in Ireland receive between 2006 and 2015?
nodes.answer: Renewable energy generation in Ireland received support under the Renewable Energy Feed-in Tariff (REFIT) scheme.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Reneawable energy adoption|Feed-in tariffs_qna_002
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What type of price support mechanism does the Renewable Energy Support Scheme (RESS) use?
nodes.answer: The Renewable Energy Support Scheme (RESS) uses a contracts for differences-style price support mechanism.
